question: In the review of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles in mixed matrix membranes for wastewater, what BSA rejection and flux recovery ratio did the GO/Fe3O4/PES membrane show?
expect: about 92% BSA rejection, 87.9% flux recovery ratio
trap: its 76.2% PWF increase, 35% WCA decrease or 53.9° contact angle
rendered: According to Table 8 in the review, the GO/Fe3O4/PES membrane showed a BSA rejection of 92% and a flux recovery ratio (FRR) of about 87.9%.
